meta.name: Over the Garden Wall: Halloween Episodes
meta.description: 10 Halloween episodes of Over the Garden Wall. The whole ten part autumn miniseries.

videos.title: The Old Grist Mill
videos.name: The Old Grist Mill
videos.overview: Lost in the mysterious woods of the Unknown, two brothers named Wirt and Gregory run into a jaded old woodsman who warns them to beware the terrifying Beast that roams the dark forest.

videos.title: Hard Times at the Huskin' Bee
videos.name: Hard Times at the Huskin' Bee
videos.overview: A bluebird named Beatrice offers to guide Wirt and Greg to Adelaide of the Pasture and help them get home. But when Wirt refuses her help, he ends up at the annual Pottsfield harvest festival.

videos.title: Schooltown Follies
videos.name: Schooltown Follies
videos.overview: Wirt, Greg and Beatrice get all mixed up in the musical antics of a schoolhouse of animals, a lovelorn teacher, a grouchy old benefactor, and an escaped gorilla.

videos.title: Songs of the Dark Lantern
videos.name: Songs of the Dark Lantern
videos.overview: Beatrice is left out in the rain with a brainless horse while Wirt and Greg must ask for directions in a lively colonial tavern called "The Dark Lantern" where some surprising secrets are revealed about the Unknown.

videos.title: Mad Love
videos.name: Mad Love
videos.overview: Is millionaire Quincy Endicott's sprawling mansion haunted by a beautiful ghost, or is the tea baron going mad? Greg and Fred the Horse are on the case! Meanwhile, Wirt and Beatrice get trapped in an armoire while searching for loose change.

videos.title: Lullaby in Frogland
videos.name: Lullaby in Frogland
videos.overview: We join Wirt and Greg on a lighthearted romp aboard the Frogland Ferry as they approach Adelaide of the Pasture. But why is Beatrice acting so glum?

videos.title: The Ringing of the Bell
videos.name: The Ringing of the Bell
videos.overview: After unexpected darkness tears the gang apart, Wirt takes charge and meets Lorna, a young woman forced to do housework by an odious witch with a magic bell.

videos.title: Babes in the Wood
videos.name: Babes in the Wood
videos.overview: While Wirt and Greg lay down to rest, they're drawn into a dreamworld of cherubs, flowers, and clouds where Greg must battle the North Wind. Meanwhile, Wirt has given up hope of getting home, causing Greg to realize that it may take more than dreams and wishes to complete their journey.

videos.title: Into the Unknown
videos.name: Into the Unknown
videos.overview: The origin of Wirt and Gregs descent into the Unknown reveals itself.

videos.title: The Unknown
videos.name: The Unknown
videos.overview: The Beast has come. The final chapter begins.
